content.text:
Built **EMBERFALL**, a playable, single-player tactical arena game in `index.html`. I assumed a turn-based match against AI was a good fit for “like Tactics Arena Online.”

- Command four distinct units on an isometric, 8×8 arena.
- Move, strike enemies in range, or use Guard and Wait.
- Take turns against AI opponents; eliminate the opposing force to win.
- Responsive layout with unit details, health, turn tracking, and a battle log.

Checked the game in desktop and mobile browsers, including movement and an AI turn. JavaScript syntax validation passed. Start a local web server in the project directory and open the page to play.
